tagline: She finally fell asleep 10 minutes ago
title: Quiet time
journal:
Arm's gone dead about twenty minutes ago. Not moving it. Moving it is how you end up back at the start, with a glass of water and one more chapter and a question about whether fish get thirsty. Brightness turned all the way down, sound off, scrolling with one thumb.

It may not sound like a picture of heaven, but I wouldn't dream of being anywhere else but here right now.

She won't remember any of this. I probably won't either, not properly. So I'm putting it here. Thursday, nearly eleven, blanket that smells of the dog, and a heartbeat slowing down against my arm.
prompt: Close and low beside sofa, a single source lights the faces of a mother and her sleeping girl as the woman holds her phone to look at while her daughter sleeps
